ptq_total_screening.Description: Perseverative Thinking Questionnaire (PTQ-15) total from the SCREENING administration, collected before enrollment and used to stratify recruitment by RT severity. This is a DIFFERENT administration from the baseline battery scored in phenotype/ptq.tsv, which was collected at the first study visit. The two correlate approximately r = 0.76 but differ for individual participants; use ptq.tsv for analyses contemporaneous with the scan session.

ptq_severity_stratum.Description: Recruitment stratum assigned from the screening PTQ score. Recruitment targeted 10% low, 30% moderate, 60% severe.
